item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00338","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C01","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied a material drafting template: both directives transfer Hawaiian land from federal military control to the Territory of Hawaii, introduce the operative conveyance with nearly parallel language, make it subject to stated conditions, and then use extensive metes-and-bounds descriptions based on Hawaii Government Survey triangulation stations and azimuths measured clockwise from true south. C01 and C21 share substantial Hawaii land-restoration language and survey conventions, but neither displays C09's additional conditional-transfer machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Title to the following-described tract of land adjoining the Honolulu Airport, Oahu, Territory of Hawaii... is hereby transferred to the Territory of Hawaii","parent_excerpt":"The following parcels of land... both located on the Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii","explanation":"Parallel operative conveyance of specifically described Oahu land from federal control to territorial jurisdiction."},{"child_excerpt":"This transfer is made subject to the following conditions","parent_excerpt":"are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii for use for road purposes, subject to the terms and conditions hereinafter stated","explanation":"Distinctive conditional-transfer structure, not merely an unconditional land restoration."},{"child_excerpt":"the coordinates of said point of beginning referred to Government Survey Triangulation Station \"Salt Lake\"... thence running by azimuths measured clockwise from true South","parent_excerpt":"the coordinates of said Monument No. 11 referred to Government Survey triangulation station \"WAIPIO-UKA\"... thence running by azimuths measured clockwise from true south","explanation":"Closely parallel Hawaii-specific survey-description formula followed by numbered courses, including curves, radii, chord azimuths, and distances."}]}
